name: android_get_logcat
description: Returns the newest logcat lines (limit, default 50), optionally only one tag, only from a minimum level up (V, D, I, W, E, F), only from one running app (package), and only from the last sinceSeconds. With crashesOnly: true, returns crash traces and ANRs from the crash buffer instead, optionally for one package (which may have died).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

crashesOnly.description: Crash buffer only: crashes and ANRs (default false).

package.description: Only this app: its running process, or with crashesOnly its crashes.

sinceSeconds.description: Only lines from the last N seconds, e.g. since a launch or tap.

limit.description: Maximum number of log lines to retrieve (default 50).
